tasks.label: ABT: executar arquivo atual
args: if [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/abt" ]; then echo 'ABT não instalado: execute python3 tools/install.py' >&2; exit 2; fi; exec "$HOME/.local/bin/abt" run "$1"

tasks.label: ABT: verificar arquivo atual
args: if [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/abt" ]; then echo 'ABT não instalado: execute python3 tools/install.py' >&2; exit 2; fi; exec "$HOME/.local/bin/abt" check "$1"
